panels.title: WS 真实错误 5m 速率
Direct Chat 失败/拒绝 5m 速率

options.content:
- 先看上方摘要定位是哪条链路异常。
- HTTP 问题看 `HTTP Detail` 的 route/error/latency。
- 连接问题看 `WebSocket Detail` 的 peer、event、close_reason；`register_rejected` 是注册拒绝，真实 WS 错误只看 `dispatch_error` / `protocol_error` / `send_error`。
- 业务对话问题看 `Direct Chat Detail` 的 event/reason/client_kind。
- 消息链路问题看 `Message Flow & Delivery Detail` 的 operation、target、delivery_kind、error_code。

panels.title: HTTP 接口报错数 by route/method（近 5m）

targets.expr: 100 * (sum by(route, method) (rate(bcs_http_requests_total{env="$env",result="error"}[5m])) or (0 * sum by(route, method) (rate(bcs_http_requests_total{env="$env"}[5m])))) / clamp_min(sum by(route, method) (rate(bcs_http_requests_total{env="$env"}[5m])), 0.001)

panels.title: HTTP latency p95 by route (普通接口)
HTTP latency p99 by route (普通接口)
HTTP latency p95 / p99 by waiting route
HTTP latency p95 / p99 by bot/provider route

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le, peer, endpoint, close_reason) (rate(bcs_ws_connection_duration_seconds_bucket{env="$env"}[5m])))

panels.title: Top direct chat failure / rejection reasons
Direct chat current runs by state/client

options.content:
- `created` 是成功创建 run 的事件。
- `capacity_rejected` 是创建前被容量保护拒绝，不会对应 `created`。
- 本大盘的异常/Top panels 聚焦 `failed` / `expired` / `capacity_rejected`；`cancelled` 和 `dropped` 属于生命周期/清理事件，只在全量 event rate 中观察。
- `increase(...)`/`rate(...)` 受 scrape 外推影响，短窗口里可能出现小数。

targets.expr: 100 * (sum by(source, operation) (rate(bcs_message_flow_requests_total{env="$env",result="error"}[5m])) or (0 * sum by(source, operation) (rate(bcs_message_flow_requests_total{env="$env"}[5m])))) / clamp_min(sum by(source, operation) (rate(bcs_message_flow_requests_total{env="$env"}[5m])), 0.001)

panels.title: Message flow error rate by source/operation

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by(target, delivery_kind, result, error_code) (rate(bcs_message_delivery_total{env="$env",result=~"failed|blocked|no_receivers"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le, target, delivery_kind, result) (rate(bcs_message_delivery_duration_seconds_bucket{env="$env"}[5m])))
